c_o2_spike.title: Suit pressure spike
c_o2_spike.text: Mia's suit regulator reads 6.2 psi and climbing. Her breathing is getting fast.
c_o2_spike.mia_line: Ground, my suit pressure is climbing — what do I do?

options.text: Switch to the backup O2 tank
Hold still and wait it out

c_o2_spike.success_line: Pressure's dropping... okay. Okay. Thanks, Ground.
c_o2_spike.fail_line: That vented a lot of oxygen. I'm okay. I think.

c_signal_drop.title: Signal dropout
c_signal_drop.text: S-band carrier lost. Telemetry frozen. The voice loop is static.

options.text: Switch the uplink to the omni antenna

c_signal_drop.success_line: There you are. Don't scare me like that.
c_signal_drop.fail_line: ...twenty minutes of static. I hate the quiet up here.
c_signal_drop.timeout_line: ...Ground? ...Ground? There you are. Twenty minutes of nothing.

c_micrometeorite.title: Micrometeorite strike
c_micrometeorite.text: Impact on the habitat skin. Pressure falling in module B.
c_micrometeorite.mia_line: Something hit the hab! Module B is losing pressure!

options.text: Seal hatch B, patch it from the inside

c_micrometeorite.success_line: Patch is holding. My hands are shaking, but it's holding.
c_micrometeorite.fail_line: We lost a lot of air before I got it sealed.

c_power_surge.title: Power bus overvolt
c_power_surge.text: Main bus B overvolt. Breakers are about to trip across the habitat.
c_power_surge.mia_line: Ground, the breaker panel is buzzing. Lights are flickering!
c_power_surge.success_line: Bus is stable. It's getting chilly though — turn the heat back on when you can.
c_power_surge.fail_line: Everything tripped. I'm in the dark for a minute.

v_hale_d1.name: Walt Hale
v_hale_d1.text: Evening. You're the new night CAPCOM? Mia's on day twelve of thirty. Keep her breathing, keep her busy, keep the logs clean. The board behind you is yours — pin anything worth remembering. Here's her brief.

v_ruth_tip.name: Ruth Okafor
v_ruth_tip.text: A rock warmer than the shadow it sits in? Pin both cards to the board and tie them with string — click one, then the other. That's how I think, anyway.

v_ruth_d2.name: Ruth Okafor
v_ruth_d2.text: The seismometer's been chattering all day. Hale says thermal creep. Funny kind of creep that keeps perfect time. Here's today's log.

v_ruth_hint_d2.name: Ruth Okafor
v_ruth_hint_d2.text: Three things beat at the same rhythm: the tremor log, the hum in her radio... and whatever the geophones heard. Tie the first two together, then tie that to the geophones.

v_hale_d3.name: Walt Hale
v_hale_d3.text: HQ wants Site Alpha off-limits. She stays inside the two-kilometer ring tonight. No detours. I don't make the rules, I just enforce them. Understood?

v_ruth_d3.name: Ruth Okafor
v_ruth_d3.text: I didn't see that fax. I didn't see anything. ...Bring her home safe.

f_d1_thermal.title: Thermal survey — Site Alpha
f_d1_thermal.body: Infrared pass complete. Shadowed regolith at Site Alpha measured at -23 °C, consistent with models. No anomalies expected.

f_d1_pse.title: Passive seismic log — Night 12
f_d1_pse.body: Three micro-tremors recorded at 02:14, 02:25 and 02:36 station time. Classified as thermal. Filed for completeness.

f_d2_supply.title: Resupply delayed
f_d2_supply.body: Selene-2 cargo lander slips to March 19. Crew is to conserve power and consumables until further notice.

f_d2_ignore.title: RE: PSE anomaly
f_d2_ignore.body: The periodic signal is an instrument fault. Log it as such. It is not to be discussed on the open loop, and the crew is not to be informed. Acknowledge.

f_d3_order.title: DIRECT ORDER
f_d3_order.body: The crew is to leave the object undisturbed and return to the habitat immediately. Do not open, move or photograph it further. This is a direct order.
